description: This file implements IndexedDB-backed persistence for managing ingestion files, including functions to add, delete, list, and clear stored files, with type definitions for upload categories and stored files.

methods.name: assertBrowser
methods.description: Checks if the code is running in a browser environment with IndexedDB support.

methods.name: openDb
methods.description: Opens the IndexedDB database, creating object store if needed.

methods.name: putIngestionFile
methods.description: Inserts or updates a stored ingestion file record in IndexedDB.

methods.name: deleteIngestionFile
methods.description: Deletes a stored ingestion file record by id from IndexedDB.

methods.name: listIngestionFiles
methods.description: Retrieves all stored ingestion file records from IndexedDB.

methods.name: clearIngestionFiles
methods.description: Clears all stored ingestion file records from IndexedDB.
